cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Name What It Cost
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the emotional cost of what happened, not merely the event itself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Six weeks without a reply. I taught you to think about the person waiting; what do you think that did to me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A good account of the equipment. Now try the person, like we practised. I didn't know about the phone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. You're finally hearing me. I kept shortening my message, trying to become easier to answer. Tell me you understand that part too; don't hand in the first correct sentence and leave.

reason: Make the teacher claim operate through actual corrections of B response and concrete invitations or demands, preserving exact Drive and all reply causes.
